انفعلوا (form VII)
# اِنْفَعَلُوا (infaʕalū) /in.fa.ʕa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
# اِنْفَعِلُوا (infaʕilū) /in.fa.ʕi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْفَعَلَ (infaʕala)
